name: Calcie Makaria
source:
Calcie comes from a large family. As the youngest, she is the only one who is not a twin—unlike her siblings, all of whom were born as part of a set of twins. Her parents struggle to provide for the family, so she and her siblings help out with daily tasks and do their best to earn their own income.

She is an energetic and optimistic young girl. Despite the hardships, she always tries to keep a smile on her face and maintain a cheerful disposition. She is also very blunt, which sometimes leads to friction with those around her.
